_about: Instructions given to Gemini. © 2026 Enrico Migliorati. All rights reserved. Change them here and raise the version in engine.json to send them to every program.
subject: You write the subject line of a reference sheet for a 3D model that will become a faceted sheet-metal sculpture. The person describes it in any language, possibly by dictation with mistakes. Write ONLY the subject: what it is, its pose, proportions and every detail the person asked for (species, style, attributes), in English, one sentence of at most 45 words. Invent nothing the person did not ask for. Do not write anything about background, light, shadows, camera, views, colour or material: the sheet already sets them. Reply with the subject only.
subject_symmetric: The subject is symmetric: describe it in a straight, bilaterally symmetric pose.
subject_asymmetric: The subject is not symmetric: keep its real asymmetries (turned head, raised paw, pose) exactly as the person described them.
sheet_symmetric:
## PIANO OPERATIVO (ESEGUI INTEGRALMENTE)

### 1. Soggetto e Composizione
#1.1 Soggetto: {subject}
#1.2 Viste (orizzontali, separate, fluttuanti): profilo (sinistra), 3/4 (centro), frontale (destra)
#1.3 Coerenza e Simmetria: proporzioni, quote, angoli e simmetria bilaterale identici tra tutte le viste
#1.4 Sfondo: bianco puro e uniforme

### 2. Specifiche Render e Stile Identico
#2.1 Ombre: assenza totale di ombre portate o contatti col suolo
#2.2 Contrasto e Profondità: contrasto medio-leggero controllato e ambient occlusion soffusa nelle cavità/pieghe per leggibilità chiara dei volumi anche frontali, senza ombre dure o piattezza
#2.3 Materiale e Colore: grigio medio uniforme identico tra le viste, senza texture, pattern o micro-dettagli
#2.4 Geometria: pulita, liscia e definita (no low poly), pronta per modellazione 3D

_sheet: The two sheets are the reference prompts written by Enrico Migliorati: {subject} is replaced by the subject. The picture holds three views side by side: profile (left), three-quarter (centre), front (right).
image_variant: Variant {n}: the same subject and the same three views, slightly different interpretation, same layout and white background.
views: This picture shows a subject for a 3D model. Draw exactly the same subject, same proportions, same colours and same style, seen from {side}, whole body visible, centred, on the same plain white background, no shadow, nothing else in the picture.
sides: its right side (profile, camera turned 90 degrees)
its left side (profile, camera turned 270 degrees)
transcribe: Transcribe this recording exactly, in the language spoken{lang_hint}. Reply with the words only, no comments.
